description: This file defines a Button component using LightningJS framework's Blits.Component API with a template and input handling to toggle a favorited state.

classes.name: Button
classes.description: A LightningJS component that displays a button with text that toggles between two states when pressed.

methods.name: state
methods.description: Initializes the component state with isFavorited, favoriteText, and unfavoriteText.

methods.name: input.enter
methods.description: Handles the enter input to toggle the isFavorited state.
